compare_countries.description: Read one name in several countries at once and see whether they agree - Kim is female in the United States and male in Denmark. Use it to decide whether a name is safe to act on when you do not know where someone is from. The worldwide reading comes back too, as the baseline. Costs one name from your monthly plan per country, plus one for the worldwide reading.

description: Predict the gender most likely behind a name with Genderize.io, from a dataset of around a billion name records covering 249 countries. Gender one name or a whole list in a single step, read a name the way a particular country uses it, or compare a name across countries to see whether the answer changes. Every prediction comes with a confidence score and the number of records behind it, so a workflow can act on the ones it is sure about and leave the rest alone. Free for 2,500 names a month.
